---
title: "`r params$title` Package Status Report"
author: "[`r params$repo`](https://github.com/`r params$repo`)"
date: "`r format(Sys.time(), '%B %d, %Y %H:%M %Z')`"
output: html_document
params:
  token: NULL
  packageList: NULL
  title: "Tidyverse"
  repo: "gh.dash"
  qualification_registry_url: NULL
  pr_activity_days: 365
  include_quality: TRUE
---

This report summarizes the current release and milestone status for a selection of `r params$title` packages hosted on GitHub.

```{r setup, message=FALSE, echo=FALSE}
library(gh.dash)

# Use token from params, fallback to automatic discovery
github_token <- params$token
qualification_registry_url <- params$qualification_registry_url
qualification_registry <- NULL
pr_activity_days <- gh.dash:::validate_lookback_days(params$pr_activity_days)

if (is.null(qualification_registry_url) || !nzchar(qualification_registry_url)) {
  qualification_registry_url <- NULL
} else {
  qualification_registry <- fetch_qualification_registry(qualification_registry_url, github_token)
}

repos <- if (is.null(params$packageList)) {
  warning("No packageList provided; report will be empty.")
  character(0)
} else {
  as.character(params$packageList)
}

status <- if (length(repos) == 0L) {
  data.frame(
    repo = character(0),
    latest_release = character(0),
    upcoming_milestones = character(0),
    issue_summary = character(0),
    open_prs = character(0),
    dev_branch_status = character(0),
    ytd_releases = character(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  summarize_github_repos(
    repos,
    token = github_token,
    qualification_registry = qualification_registry
  )
}

pr_activity <- if (length(repos) == 0L) {
  empty <- data.frame(
    user = character(0),
    prs_opened = integer(0),
    prs_opened_active = integer(0),
    prs_reviewed = integer(0),
    prs_pending_review = integer(0),
    total_activity = integer(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  empty$pending_review_repos <- I(list())
  empty$opened_active_repos <- I(list())
  empty
} else {
  summarize_pr_activity_by_user(
    repos,
    token = github_token,
    days = pr_activity_days
  )
}

quality <- if (!isTRUE(params$include_quality) || length(repos) == 0L) {
  data.frame(
    repo = character(0),
    test_count = integer(0),
    qcthat_status = character(0),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
} else {
  gh.dash:::summarize_repo_quality(
    repos,
    token = github_token
  )
}
```

```{r status_table, echo=FALSE}
render_status_table <- function(df) {
  if (!nrow(df)) {
    return(htmltools::div(class = "empty-state", "No repositories available."))
  }

  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    htmltools::tags$tr(
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--repo col-repo",
        htmltools::HTML(df$repo[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell col-latest-release",
        htmltools::HTML(df$latest_release[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell col-open-milestones",
        htmltools::HTML(df$upcoming_milestones[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell col-issues",
        htmltools::HTML(df$issue_summary[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell col-open-prs",
        htmltools::HTML(df$open_prs[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell col-dev-status",
        htmltools::HTML(df$dev_branch_status[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--right col-releases",
        htmltools::HTML(df$ytd_releases[[i]])
      )
    )
  })

  tbody <- htmltools::tagAppendChildren(htmltools::tags$tbody(), rows)

  htmltools::div(
      class = "status-table-wrapper",
      htmltools::div(
        class = "status-table-toolbar",
        htmltools::div(
          class = "column-settings",
          htmltools::tags$button(
            class = "column-settings__button",
            type = "button",
            `aria-expanded` = "false",
            `aria-haspopup` = "true",
            `aria-label` = "Column settings",
            "⚙ Settings"
          ),
          htmltools::div(
            class = "column-settings__panel",
            htmltools::tags$div(class = "column-settings__title", "Table Columns"),
            htmltools::tags$div(
              class = "column-settings__actions",
              htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "column-settings__action", `data-column-action` = "hide-all", "Hide all"),
              htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "column-settings__action", `data-column-action` = "show-all", "Show all")
            ),
            htmltools::tags$div(
              class = "column-settings__list",
              htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-repo", checked = "checked"), "Repository"),
              htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-latest-release", checked = "checked"), "Latest release"),
              htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-open-milestones", checked = "checked"), "Open milestones"),
              htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-issues", checked = "checked"), "Issues (open/closed)"),
              htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-open-prs", checked = "checked"), "Open PRs"),
              htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-dev-status", checked = "checked"), "Dev status"),
              htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-releases", checked = "checked"), "# Releases")
            )
          )
        )
      ),
      htmltools::div(
        class = "status-table-container",
        htmltools::tags$table(
          class = "status-table",
          htmltools::tags$thead(
            htmltools::tags$tr(
              htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "col-repo", "Repository"),
              htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "col-latest-release", "Latest release"),
              htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "col-open-milestones", "Open milestones"),
              htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "col-issues", "Issues (open/closed)"),
              htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "col-open-prs", "Open PRs"),
              htmltools::tags$th(
                scope = "col",
                class = "col-dev-status",
                htmltools::tagList(
                  "Dev status",
                  htmltools::tags$span(
                    class = "info-icon",
                    `data-tooltip` = "The difference in commits between 'main' and 'dev' branches: \n A positive number means dev is ahead of main by n commits; \n A negative number means dev is behind main by n commits;\n \"Unavailable\" means that there is no branch named 'dev' and/or 'main'.",
                    `aria-label` = "The difference in commits between 'main' and 'dev' branches: A positive number means dev is ahead of main by n commits; A negative number means dev is behind main by n commits; \"Unavailable\" means that there is no branch named 'dev' and/or 'main'.",
                    tabindex = "0",
                    "i"
                  )
                )
              ),
              htmltools::tags$th(
                scope = "col",
                class = "status-table__cell--right col-releases",
                htmltools::tagList(
                  "# Releases",
                  htmltools::tags$span(
                    class = "info-icon",
                    `data-tooltip` = "Number of releases over the past 365 days",
                    `aria-label` = "Number of releases over the past 365 days",
                    tabindex = "0",
                    "i"
                  )
                )
              )
            )
          ),
          tbody
        )
      )
    )
}

render_pr_activity_table <- function(df, days) {
  if (!nrow(df)) {
    return(htmltools::div(
      class = "empty-state",
      sprintf("No PR activity found in the past %d days.", days)
    ))
  }

  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    opened <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$prs_opened[[i]]))
    reviewed <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(df$prs_reviewed[[i]]))

    ratio <- if (!is.finite(reviewed) || reviewed <= 0) {
      if (is.finite(opened) && opened > 0) {
        "∞"
      } else {
        "0.00"
      }
    } else {
      sprintf("%.2f", opened / reviewed)
    }

    pending_count <- df$prs_pending_review[[i]]
    pending_repos <- df$pending_review_repos[[i]]
    since_date <- format(Sys.Date() - days, "%Y-%m-%d")
    base_url <- paste0(
      "https://github.com/pulls?q=is:open+is:pr+review-requested:",
      utils::URLencode(df$user[[i]], reserved = FALSE),
      "+updated:>=", since_date
    )
    if (length(pending_repos) > 0) {
      repo_qs <- paste0("+repo:", pending_repos, collapse = "")
      full_url <- if (nchar(paste0(base_url, repo_qs)) <= 2000L) {
        paste0(base_url, repo_qs)
      } else {
        base_url
      }
    } else {
      full_url <- base_url
    }
    tooltip_text <- paste(pending_repos, collapse = "\n")
    pending_aria <- if (length(pending_repos) > 0) {
      paste0(pending_count, " PR(s) pending review in: ", paste(pending_repos, collapse = ", "))
    } else {
      paste0(pending_count, " PR(s) pending review")
    }
    pending_cell <- if (!is.na(pending_count) && pending_count > 0L) {
      htmltools::tags$a(
        href = full_url,
        target = "_blank",
        rel = "noopener noreferrer",
        class = "pr-activity-link",
        `aria-label` = pending_aria,
        `data-tooltip` = tooltip_text,
        as.character(pending_count)
      )
    } else {
      "0"
    }

    # -- Opened (Active) cell --
    active_count <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(df$prs_opened_active[[i]]))
    if (is.na(active_count)) active_count <- 0L
    active_repos <- df$opened_active_repos[[i]]
    active_base_url <- paste0(
      "https://github.com/pulls?q=is:open+is:pr+author:",
      utils::URLencode(df$user[[i]], reserved = FALSE),
      "+created:>=",
      since_date
    )
    if (length(active_repos) > 0) {
      active_repo_qs <- paste0("+repo:", active_repos, collapse = "")
      active_full_url <- if (nchar(paste0(active_base_url, active_repo_qs)) <= 2000L) {
        paste0(active_base_url, active_repo_qs)
      } else {
        active_base_url
      }
    } else {
      active_full_url <- active_base_url
    }
    active_tooltip <- paste(active_repos, collapse = "\n")
    active_aria <- if (length(active_repos) > 0) {
      paste0(active_count, " active open PR(s) in: ", paste(active_repos, collapse = ", "))
    } else {
      paste0(active_count, " active open PR(s)")
    }
    active_part <- if (active_count > 0L) {
      htmltools::tags$a(
        href = active_full_url,
        target = "_blank",
        rel = "noopener noreferrer",
        class = "pr-activity-link",
        `aria-label` = active_aria,
        `data-tooltip` = active_tooltip,
        as.character(active_count)
      )
    } else {
      "0"
    }
    opened_cell <- htmltools::tagList(
      paste0(as.character(df$prs_opened[[i]]), " ("),
      active_part,
      ")"
    )

    htmltools::tags$tr(
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "status-table__cell", htmltools::htmlEscape(df$user[[i]])),
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--right", opened_cell),
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--right", as.character(df$prs_reviewed[[i]])),
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--right", pending_cell),
      htmltools::tags$td(class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--right", ratio)
    )
  })

  tbody <- htmltools::tagAppendChildren(htmltools::tags$tbody(), rows)

  htmltools::div(
    class = "status-table-wrapper",
    htmltools::div(
      class = "status-table-container",
      htmltools::tags$table(
        class = "status-table status-table--compact",
        htmltools::tags$thead(
          htmltools::tags$tr(
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", "User"),
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "status-table__cell--right", "PRs Opened (Active)"),
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "status-table__cell--right", "PRs Reviewed"),
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "status-table__cell--right", "PRs Pending Review"),
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "status-table__cell--right", "Created/Reviewed")
          )
        ),
        tbody
      )
    )
  )
}

render_quality_table <- function(df) {
  if (!nrow(df)) {
    return(htmltools::div(
      class = "empty-state",
      "No repositories available."
    ))
  }

  rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(df)), function(i) {
    htmltools::tags$tr(
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--repo col-quality-repo",
        htmltools::HTML(df$repo[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--right col-coverage",
        htmltools::HTML(df$coverage[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell status-table__cell--right col-test-count",
        if (is.na(df$test_count[[i]])) "\u2014" else as.character(df$test_count[[i]])
      ),
      htmltools::tags$td(
        class = "status-table__cell col-qcthat",
        htmltools::htmlEscape(df$qcthat_status[[i]])
      )
    )
  })

  tbody <- htmltools::tagAppendChildren(htmltools::tags$tbody(), rows)

  htmltools::div(
    class = "status-table-wrapper",
    htmltools::div(
      class = "status-table-toolbar",
      htmltools::div(
        class = "column-settings",
        htmltools::tags$button(
          type = "button",
          class = "column-settings__button",
          `aria-expanded` = "false",
          `aria-controls` = "quality-column-settings-panel",
          `aria-label` = "Column settings",
          "\u2630 Columns"
        ),
        htmltools::div(
          id = "quality-column-settings-panel",
          class = "column-settings__panel",
          htmltools::tags$div(class = "column-settings__title", "Table Columns"),
          htmltools::div(
            class = "column-settings__actions",
            htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "column-settings__action", `data-column-action` = "hide-all", "Hide all"),
            htmltools::tags$button(type = "button", class = "column-settings__action", `data-column-action` = "show-all", "Show all")
          ),
          htmltools::tags$ul(
            class = "column-settings__list",
            htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-quality-repo", checked = "checked"), "Repository"),
            htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-coverage", checked = "checked"), "Coverage"),
            htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-test-count", checked = "checked"), "# of tests"),
            htmltools::tags$label(class = "column-settings__item", htmltools::tags$input(type = "checkbox", `data-column` = "col-qcthat", checked = "checked"), "uses qcthat")
          )
        )
      )
    ),
    htmltools::div(
      class = "status-table-container",
      htmltools::tags$table(
        class = "status-table status-table--compact",
        htmltools::tags$thead(
          htmltools::tags$tr(
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "col-quality-repo", "Repository"),
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "status-table__cell--right col-coverage", "Coverage"),
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "status-table__cell--right col-test-count", "# of tests"),
            htmltools::tags$th(scope = "col", class = "col-qcthat", "uses qcthat")
          )
        ),
        tbody
      )
    )
  )
}

render_dashboard_tabs <- function(status_df, pr_activity_df, quality_df, days, include_quality) {
  tab_buttons <- list(
    htmltools::tags$button(
      class = "dash-tabs__button is-active",
      type = "button",
      `data-tab-target` = "tab-repo-status",
      "Repository Status"
    ),
    htmltools::tags$button(
      class = "dash-tabs__button",
      type = "button",
      `data-tab-target` = "tab-pr-activity",
      sprintf("PR Activity (Last %d Days)", days)
    )
  )

  tab_panels <- list(
    htmltools::div(
      id = "tab-repo-status",
      class = "dash-tab-panel is-active",
      render_status_table(status_df)
    ),
    htmltools::div(
      id = "tab-pr-activity",
      class = "dash-tab-panel",
      render_pr_activity_table(pr_activity_df, days)
    )
  )

  if (isTRUE(include_quality)) {
    tab_buttons <- c(
      tab_buttons,
      list(htmltools::tags$button(
        class = "dash-tabs__button",
        type = "button",
        `data-tab-target` = "tab-quality",
        "Quality"
      ))
    )
    tab_panels <- c(
      tab_panels,
      list(htmltools::div(
        id = "tab-quality",
        class = "dash-tab-panel",
        render_quality_table(quality_df)
      ))
    )
  }

  htmltools::browsable(
    htmltools::div(
      class = "dash-tabs",
      htmltools::div(
        class = "dash-tabs__list",
        tab_buttons
      ),
      tab_panels
    )
  )
}

render_dashboard_tabs(status, pr_activity, quality, pr_activity_days, params$include_quality)
```

```{r column_settings_js, echo=FALSE, results='asis'}
column_settings_js <- c(
  "<script>",
  "(function() {",
  "  var wrappers = document.querySelectorAll('.status-table-wrapper');",
  "  wrappers.forEach(function(wrapper) {",
  "    var button = wrapper.querySelector('.column-settings__button');",
  "    var panel = wrapper.querySelector('.column-settings__panel');",
  "    if (!button || !panel) return;",
  "",
  "    var checkboxes = Array.prototype.slice.call(panel.querySelectorAll('input[type=\"checkbox\"][data-column]'));",
  "    var hideAll = panel.querySelector('[data-column-action=\"hide-all\"]');",
  "    var showAll = panel.querySelector('[data-column-action=\"show-all\"]');",
  "",
  "    function setColumnVisible(columnClass, visible) {",
  "      var cells = wrapper.querySelectorAll('.' + columnClass);",
  "      cells.forEach(function(cell) {",
  "        cell.style.display = visible ? '' : 'none';",
  "      });",
  "    }",
  "",
  "    function ensureAtLeastOneVisible() {",
  "      var anyChecked = checkboxes.some(function(cb) { return cb.checked; });",
  "      if (!anyChecked) {",
  "        var repoCb = checkboxes.find(function(cb) { return cb.getAttribute('data-column') === 'col-repo'; });",
  "        if (repoCb) {",
  "          repoCb.checked = true;",
  "          setColumnVisible('col-repo', true);",
  "        }",
  "      }",
  "    }",
  "",
  "    checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {",
  "      cb.addEventListener('change', function() {",
  "        setColumnVisible(cb.getAttribute('data-column'), cb.checked);",
  "        ensureAtLeastOneVisible();",
  "      });",
  "    });",
  "",
  "    if (hideAll) {",
  "      hideAll.addEventListener('click', function() {",
  "        checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {",
  "          cb.checked = false;",
  "          setColumnVisible(cb.getAttribute('data-column'), false);",
  "        });",
  "        ensureAtLeastOneVisible();",
  "      });",
  "    }",
  "",
  "    if (showAll) {",
  "      showAll.addEventListener('click', function() {",
  "        checkboxes.forEach(function(cb) {",
  "          cb.checked = true;",
  "          setColumnVisible(cb.getAttribute('data-column'), true);",
  "        });",
  "      });",
  "    }",
  "",
  "    button.addEventListener('click', function(event) {",
  "      event.stopPropagation();",
  "      var isOpen = panel.classList.toggle('is-open');",
  "      button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', isOpen ? 'true' : 'false');",
  "    });",
  "",
  "    panel.addEventListener('click', function(event) {",
  "      event.stopPropagation();",
  "    });",
  "",
  "    document.addEventListener('click', function() {",
  "      if (panel.classList.contains('is-open')) {",
  "        panel.classList.remove('is-open');",
  "        button.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');",
  "      }",
  "    });",
  "  });",
  "",
  "  var tabButtons = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.dash-tabs__button[data-tab-target]'));",
  "  var tabPanels = Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.dash-tab-panel'));",
  "",
  "  function activateTab(targetId) {",
  "    tabButtons.forEach(function(button) {",
  "      var isActive = button.getAttribute('data-tab-target') === targetId;",
  "      button.classList.toggle('is-active', isActive);",
  "    });",
  "",
  "    tabPanels.forEach(function(panel) {",
  "      panel.classList.toggle('is-active', panel.id === targetId);",
  "    });",
  "  }",
  "",
  "  tabButtons.forEach(function(button) {",
  "    button.addEventListener('click', function() {",
  "      activateTab(button.getAttribute('data-tab-target'));",
  "    });",
  "  });",
  "})();",
  "</script>"
)

cat(paste(column_settings_js, collapse = '\n'))
```
